_readme: Copy to appsettings.Live.json (git-ignored) and start the kernel with ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Live to run against real tools. Credentials never go in this file: SMTP/IMAP passwords are imported into the DPAPI store from data/setup-secrets.json on startup (see docs/PUBLIC-EDITION.md).

Lan._note: LAN voice endpoint (phone PWA). If you enable it, add this PC's LAN address to AllowedHosts; requests from the LAN must carry the X-Jarvis-Key header.

Graph._setup: Azure app registration with 'Allow public client flows' enabled; say 'connect microsoft' to sign in with a device code.
